text: Such intenuar score more test runs than anyone in history but according to the ICC at least 30 betters had a better peak than him. His highest ever test rating 898, Virat Kohli peaked at 937, even Sunil Gavaskar went past 900. So how is the greatest running score of all time is not even in top 30. But before we understand why, if you are a true cricket man, you must follow this page.

Here is how the rating works. It's not a career score, it's a moving average and your recent matches count the most. And it does not treat every run the same, run against strong teams and the runs that win matches earn more.
That is problem number 1, some of the Sachin's greatest in ink tests and rates came in losses, 114 in Perth

169 in Cape Town, 136 in Chennai against Pakistan, India lost all of them. Problem number 2, right after his peak in 2002, tennis elbow hit him, the bad matches dragged the average down and it never recovered to that height.

He became number 1 again in 2010 but even then 898 stayed his selling. So the rating says Sachin never had a monster peak but 24 years, 200 tests and 15,921 runs, maybe his greatness was never the peak.
Maybe his greatness was never the peak, it was the mountain range.
